summary.text: 19 attack families, each blocked by its rule; 0/50 false positives (regression suite)

not_counted.why: not counted until Base is live: the testnet scan fixes open_auth_until at 0

families.attack: extra full-access key
extra function-call key to the agent with owner-like methods
extra function-call key to a foreign contract
runner-looking key added with the setup key, not by the contract
patched wasm (code hash differs)
same interface plus an upgrade / self-deploy method
extra method that is not in the published contract
seller changed terms after the buyer was quoted
open approval on the deed
pre-signed Base authorization still valid
Base wallet address set at init to an address the seller controls
setup full-access key never deleted
one RPC provider hides a key
runner key scope widened beyond runner methods
contract lists a key the account does not have
known_keys_hash forged
agent already frozen (backdoor proven)
deployed with the seller's own admin or payment token
earn-out terms below the buyer's minimum (no escrow, seller floor, short window)
seller filled the round-trip table so the buyer inherits PaidToFull

not_caught_by_design.not_caught: Copies of off-chain code, prompts, model weights
not_caught_by_design.why: Not on-chain; the earn-out prices it in

not_caught_by_design.not_caught: Outside API keys and accounts (LLM keys, market tokens, customer contacts)
Sybil payers on aged, fresh or exchange-funded accounts
not_caught_by_design.why: Look like customers on-chain; the meter only flags self, sub-accounts and round trips; earn-out share <= 50% makes wash-paying cost money

not_caught_by_design.not_caught: A hidden full-access key used directly by a buyer who skipped the scan
not_caught_by_design.why: The contract cannot list its own keys; the SDK and MCP never skip the scan; a hidden key calling the contract freezes it (A23)

not_caught_by_design.not_caught: Customers moving off-platform after the sale
A compromised MPC network, NEAR AI signer or both RPC providers

contract_layer.what: buy with the listing version the buyer scanned after the seller changed terms: refused ListingChanged, full refund
buy with a known_keys_hash that no longer matches: refused KeysChanged, full refund
list with an open deed approval: refused OpenApproval
deed moved outside buy(): runner keys deleted, agent paused
buyer signs with their own key before the handover callback to fake a backdoor: NotRunner, no freeze, escrow kept
hidden key calls the contract as the agent: frozen, escrow back to buyer
